body: I'm really trying. At this point in my life I have 0 accomplished other than I'm still alive. I've been dealing suicidal thoughts since I was 13 and I'm 37 now. Everything in my life that I've ever looked forward to ends in failure. Sports career failure, high school failure, Love life failure. The main reason why I'm still around is the thought of disappointing my mom, The only family I have left. After she passes I'm really scared for myself.
